content.headline: The Blueprint for a Smarter Continent
content.subhead: By the numbers and on the ground—here is how Bluetone is driving the autonomous revolution across Africa's leading transit hubs.

testimonials.name: Amara Okafor
testimonials.title: Director of Urban Planning
testimonials.quote: Bluetone isn't just selling vehicles; they are providing the infrastructure for a cleaner, smarter Lagos. Their commitment to cultural adaptation is unparalleled.
testimonials.image_prompt: High-end professional business portrait of a Nigerian woman in her 40s, wearing a tailored blazer with subtle coral accents, soft office lighting, bokeh Lagos city background, 8k resolution.

testimonials.name: Kofi Mensah
testimonials.title: Chief Operations Officer
testimonials.quote: The autonomous integration has reduced our operational delays by 30% while perfectly navigating our unique local traffic environments.
testimonials.image_prompt: Professional headshot of a Ghanaian man in his 50s, executive leadership style, wearing a crisp charcoal suit, modern transit hub architecture in background, natural daylight.

testimonials.name: Zanele Mbeki
testimonials.title: Head of Sustainability
testimonials.quote: Switching our fleet to Bluetone's electric transit has drastically cut our carbon footprint without sacrificing the reliability our clients demand.
testimonials.image_prompt: Corporate portrait of a South African woman, sustainability executive, confident expression, minimalist modern office with greenery, soft warm lighting, professional photography.

testimonials.name: Ibrahim Yusuf
testimonials.title: Founder
testimonials.quote: Their law-abiding robots have revolutionized our last-mile delivery in complex urban environments where traditional logistics often fail.
testimonials.image_prompt: Professional portrait of a West African male tech entrepreneur, clean smart-casual attire, blurred tech-hub background, crisp focus, high-end editorial style.
